title: Choose UniMind's visual world
question: Choose the visual system that should carry the bilingual student, Batch Leader, and admin experience.

options.label: The Study Route
options.lineage: Egyptian campus wayfinding, route diagrams, and timetable boards
options.thesis: The authorized curriculum path becomes a route students can read at a glance and enter without losing context.
options.viewport: A continuous catalog route crosses the first viewport; the authorized unit opens directly into an evidence-aware study workspace rather than a dashboard card grid.
options.risk: It becomes a transit theme if route logic stops doing real navigation work.

raised.raise: Availability transitions use explicit named phases, not vague disabled styling.
Every state combines wording, shape, and iconography so color is never the only signal.
Source, quota, and readiness indicators behave like calibrated readouts.
Mobile folding and capacity limits stay explicit instead of disappearing into overflow.

options.label: The Annotated Atlas
options.lineage: scientific atlas plates, tracing overlays, and numbered marginalia
options.thesis: UniMind reveals one curriculum unit as a living evidence plate whose sources and states can always be traced.
options.viewport: A full-canvas unit atlas owns the screen, with the catalog path in the margin and evidence/status callouts attached to the exact workspace regions they explain.
options.risk: Its strongest association is medical publishing, so later programs require disciplined non-clinical content.

options.label: The Unit Case Wall
options.lineage: sneaker archive walls and indexed box-end labels
options.thesis: Curriculum units become clearly indexed cases that open to reveal their current material and study workspace.
options.viewport: A structured wall of bilingual unit labels fills the view; the selected case slides open and exposes source readiness and the primary study action.
options.case: Strong student-cultural familiarity and excellent dense indexing; weaker than The Study Route at explaining hierarchical authorization.
options.risk: The product can feel collectible or retail-oriented if the cases become decorative cards.

options.label: The Study Shelf
options.lineage: streaming catalog walls and focus-expanding title rails
options.thesis: Authorized study choices stay visually immediate while the focused unit expands into its safe status and next action.
options.viewport: Bilingual curriculum rails cross the screen; one focused unit expands with readiness, source count, and an unmistakable enter-workspace action.
options.case: Extremely familiar browsing on phone and desktop; weaker than The Study Route for deep hierarchy, long labels, and sustained task focus.
options.risk: It can make serious study feel like entertainment browsing and horizontal rails demand careful accessibility work.

options.label: Readiness Horizon
options.thesis: The workspace changes atmosphere as material moves from unavailable to study-ready.
options.viewport: Availability phases form broad horizon bands behind the active unit.
options.case: Beautiful state storytelling, but atmosphere obscures catalog hierarchy and ordinary controls.
options.kept: Named availability phases remain explicit in the selected direction.
options.risk: State can become mood instead of precise operational information.

options.label: Curriculum Grid
options.thesis: Every unit and state occupies a strict, readable grid cell with unmistakable feedback.
options.viewport: A whole-tile curriculum map exposes current position and allowed moves.
options.case: The state grammar is clear, but the game association conflicts with UniMind's anti-gamification boundary.
options.kept: Status remains redundant across text, icon, and shape rather than depending on color.
options.risk: The visual language promises play and scoring instead of dependable study.

options.label: Evidence Signal Bench
options.lineage: oscilloscope graticules and calibrated instrument readouts
options.thesis: UniMind separates supported study signals from unavailable or conflicting material with calibrated precision.
options.viewport: One measured field overlays source status, evidence, and unit scope.
options.case: Excellent evidence metaphor, but it overfits technical subjects and risks hospital-system sterility.
options.kept: Readiness, source, and quota values behave as calibrated readouts.
options.risk: The interface can become intimidating and instrument-like for ordinary navigation.

options.label: Study J-Card
options.lineage: hand-ruled cassette j-cards and timed track lists
options.thesis: A unit unfolds into a finite, personally legible study plan with visible capacity.
options.viewport: The selected unit unfolds from a compact spine into bilingual content and status columns.
options.case: The personal-study feel resonates, but an audio-first artifact distorts UniMind's source-neutral model.
options.kept: Capacity and mobile folding remain visible and intentional.
options.risk: Nostalgia may dominate the product and make non-audio sources feel secondary.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A highly polished learning workspace with familiar navigation, filters, and content panels.
canonCard.viewport: A sidebar, breadcrumb, filter row, and central workspace use the arrangement students already expect from modern learning software.
canonCard.risk: It is immediately usable but deliberately indistinguishable from other learning platforms.
